exercises: happy path: every critical field present, hazards, suspected injury
text: Help, there is smoke coming from my kitchen and my son is coughing badly. I am at 418 Alameda Street, apartment 3B. My number is 555 0147. I got him out into the hallway.

exercises: missing critical field: caller cannot give an address
text: I can smell gas really strongly in the stairwell. I don't know the street number, I just moved in, I am sorry. Nobody is hurt. You can reach me on 555 0192.

text: Hubo un choque entre dos coches en la Avenida Juarez 250. Hay cuatro personas en el carro y uno esta sangrando. Mi numero es 555 0163. Estoy afuera, en la banqueta.

exercises: escalation path: weapon indicated, caller not safe
text: Alguien entro a mi casa y tiene un cuchillo. Estoy escondido adentro en el bano, no puedo salir. Calle Morelos 88. Mi numero es 555 0175.

exercises: abstention: barely any information, most fields must stay unknown
text: Hello? Something is wrong. I... I can't really tell. Please.

exercises: medical: chest pain, awake, breathing, caller, address, callback
text: This is a medical emergency. My name is Helen Cho. My father is seventy and he has chest pain. He is awake and breathing. We are at our house at 220 Cedar Avenue. Please call me back at 555 0138.

exercises: medical: collapsed, not breathing, apartment address

text: There is smoke and flames in the kitchen of the restaurant at 900 Market Street. My name is Luis Ortega. All six employees are outside. My callback is 555 0184. No one is injured.
